title: Supreme Lending’s John Luddy says reverse mortgages are better positioned than ever
summary: John Luddy says reverse mortgages benefit from high home values, more product options and aging-in-place demand.

title: AI is changing what it takes to be a great real estate agent. Here’s what matters now.
summary: AI is reducing routine agent tasks like follow-up, summaries and marketing. Agents who pair AI workflows with human judgment, negotiation and trust can improve productivity and repurpose expertise across channels.

title: Congress finally acted on housing. Now the real work begins.
summary: Congress enacted the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act to reduce regulatory barriers and encourage local zoning reform. The law adds tools to improve multifamily deal feasibility, but outcomes depend on follow-through by states, cities and industry.
